findings.highlight: My pajamas are heavy with sweat. I kick off the covers.
findings.evidenceJa: 寝巻きは汗を吸って重く、掛け布団は蹴り飛ばされている。
findings.governingReading: He wakes from difficult sleep with sweat-heavy pajamas and the quilt already kicked away.
findings.explanation: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.
